description:
List a workspace's rate limits.

By default, returns only the groups and limiter types that have a
workspace-level override. With `include_inherited=true`, returns every
group with organization-level limits the workspace can see, listing for
each the values it inherits from the organization as well as its own
overrides. Each value's `source` says which it is.

When `limit` is omitted, every matching entry is returned in a single
page; when `limit` truncates the result, follow `next_page` to fetch
the remaining entries.

parameters.description: Also list the limiter values the workspace inherits from the organization, including groups with no workspace-level override.
parameters.name: include_inherited

schema.description: Also list the limiter values the workspace inherits from the organization, including groups with no workspace-level override.
schema.title: Include Inherited

parameters.description:
Maximum number of items to return per page. Ranges from `1` to `1000`.

When omitted, every remaining entry is returned in a single page and `next_page` is `null`.
parameters.name: limit

schema.description:
Maximum number of items to return per page. Ranges from `1` to `1000`.

schema.title: Limit
